Company Snapshot.
• The shareholders’ equity value at March 2009 was
KES 4.1 billion
• Centum has since made dividend distributions to
shareholders amounting to KES 4.5 billion
• With new equity capital raised between 2009 - 2022,
Centum has distributed KES 400 million in excess
of the original equity value.
• As of 30 September 2022, the shareholder equity value
was KES 39.8 billion
• Thus, the gross value created for shareholders over
the 2009 – 2022 period was KES 40.2 billion
• This represents an annualized return on equity of
20% p.a against the NSE 20 Index return of -3.75%
in the period.
